description: Specify constants where known, use actual values instead of placeholders. Describe stub return values in Givens. Don't parameterize stubbed inputs. Example: 'payment_rules/common/' (constant) not '{rules_path}' (placeholder).

do.description: Use actual constants, describe stubs explicitly. Example: 'Given Payment validators are stubbed to return {...}' with actual JSON

guidance.description: Use actual constants for fixed paths and structures
Describe stub return values explicitly in Givens
example: Given Payment validators are stubbed to return '{"violations": [...], "validators_executed": 1}'

guidance.description: Use actual class names and file paths

dont.description: Don't parameterize constants or stubbed inputs. Example: '{common_rules_path}' when always 'payment_rules/common/' (wrong)

guidance.description: Don't parameterize inputs that are stubbed
example: Given Payment data '{payment_data}' And validators are stubbed (WRONG - data doesn't matter if stubbed)
Given Payment validators are configured (WRONG - doesn't show what stubs return)
